content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you are well. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to clarify a few points:
- The relevant clause allows termination immediately if a financing condition is not met, which could end the contract without compensation for work already performed. I propose that either Party may terminate the agreement upon written notice only after a material breach, and the terminating Party shall pay the other Party all undisputed fees earned up to the effective date of termination.

Thank you for reviewing these suggestions. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Best regards
